title: Senior Technical Superintendent
description:
**As a Senior Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and cost-effective technical operation of assigned vessels. This role is pivotal in maintaining operational excellence and environmental compliance while fostering strong collaboration between ship and shore. You will play a key part in supporting strategic goals, delivering high-quality ship management services, and upholding safety and regulatory standards.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and control the technical performance of assigned vessels to ensure safety, efficiency, and compliance with contractual obligations.
* Maintain close communication with clients and build strong working relationships to support operational needs.
* Provide technical and operational support to vessels, including troubleshooting and implementing solutions for performance improvement.
* Develop and oversee maintenance and repair plans, including drydock activities, ensuring timely and accurate execution.
* Prepare, monitor, and report vessel budgets, ensuring cost efficiency and commercial viability.
* Ensure compliance with maritime legislation, safety regulations, and certification requirements.
* Plan and execute vessel inspections, audits, and follow-up actions to enhance operational standards.
* Promote and implement health, safety, environmental, and quality policies onboard vessels.
* Support and mentor sea staff, identify training needs, and provide onboard training during visits.
* Manage purchasing activities and ensure timely handling of ship requisitions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the Company Management System.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, OR Chief Engineer’s qualification.
* Minimum 3 years of sailing experience as Senior Officer OR 3 years of shore experience as Technical Superintendent in a ship management or owning company.
* Experience with Container vessels is essential.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of vessel technical requirements and voyage regulations.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective negotiation and people management abilities.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in PC applications and digital tools.

**Why You Should Join Us!**
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
  
  

* On-the-job training.
* First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family!

title: Administrator
description:
Job Summary
  

We are looking for a proactive, well-organized, and responsible
**Administrator**
to manage the day-to-day operations of a commercial building. The ideal candidate will be responsible for tenant coordination, rent collection, building maintenance, vendor management, staff supervision, financial administration, and ensuring the smooth functioning of all building facilities.

The candidate should have strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and administrative skills, with the ability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently and maintain positive relationships with tenants, vendors, service providers, and management.

Key Responsibilities
  

* Manage the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the commercial building.
* Coordinate with tenants regarding enquiries, complaints, maintenance requests, lease agreements, and renewals.
* Monitor and ensure timely collection of rent, maintenance charges, utility bills, and other applicable payments.
* Maintain accurate records of rental agreements, tenant details, payment receipts, outstanding dues, and lease expiry dates.
* Follow up with tenants regarding overdue payments and prepare regular collection and outstanding payment reports.
* Coordinate building maintenance activities, including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, lift, generator, and other facility-related services.
* Schedule and monitor preventive maintenance to ensure building equipment and facilities remain in good working condition.
* Supervise housekeeping, security personnel, maintenance staff, and other building support teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, and service providers for repairs, maintenance, and facility-related services.
* Obtain and compare quotations, verify vendor invoices, and coordinate service agreements and payment approvals.
* Monitor electricity, water, and other utility consumption and support cost-control initiatives.
* Ensure the cleanliness and proper maintenance of common areas, parking facilities, wash rooms, and other shared spaces.
* Coordinate fire safety inspections, emergency preparedness, safety procedures, and statutory compliance documentation.
* Maintain records of building expenses, maintenance costs, vendor payments, utility bills, and other operational expenditures.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering rent collection, outstanding payments, maintenance activities, expenses, tenant complaints, and building operations.
* Handle tenant complaints and operational issues promptly, escalating major concerns to management when required.
* Maintain building-related documents, contracts, licences, inspection records, and other administrative files.
* Assist management with budgeting, operational planning, expense monitoring, and facility improvement initiatives.
* Ensure that confidential tenant, financial, and company information is handled appropriately.
* Perform any additional administrative or operational duties assigned by management.

Required Skills
  

* Strong organizational, administrative, and coordination skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience in tenant relationship management and customer service.
* Knowledge of rent collection, payment follow-ups, and outstanding dues management.
* Ability to coordinate building maintenance and facility management activities.
* Vendor and contractor management skills.
* Basic knowledge of rental agreements, lease administration, and property documentation.
* Ability to monitor expenses, verify invoices, and maintain financial records.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and complaint-handling abilities.
* Ability to supervise staff and coordinate multiple service providers.
* Good time management, attention to detail, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple operational responsibilities.
* Professional attitude, integrity, accountability, and confidentiality.

Technical Skills
  

* Microsoft Excel for rent tracking, payment records, expense monitoring, and reporting.
* Microsoft Word for official letters, notices, agreements, and documentation.
* Microsoft Outlook and professional email communication.
* Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive.
* Basic knowledge of accounting and billing (Not Mandatory)
* Ability to maintain digital and physical records systematically.

Educational Qualification
  

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, Facility Management, Property Management, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in commercial building administration, facility management, property management, or office administration will be an advantage.

Experience
  

* Preferably 1–3 years of experience in commercial building administration, property management, facility management, or a similar role.
* Experience handling tenants, rent collection, vendor coordination, maintenance, and operational reporting is preferred.

Preferred Qualities
  

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Proactive approach to maintenance and operational problem-solving.
* Ability to manage tenant relationships professionally.
* High level of responsibility, reliability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage priorities and resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Practical approach to cost control and operational efficiency.
* Willingness to take ownership of building operations and coordinate effectively with management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

* Timely rent and maintenance charge collection.
* Reduction in overdue tenant payments.
* Timely resolution of tenant complaints and maintenance requests.
* Completion of preventive maintenance according to schedule.
* Effective control of building operating expenses.
* Accuracy of financial records, invoices, and operational reports.
* Compliance with applicable building safety and documentation requirements.
* Tenant satisfaction and overall building maintenance standards.

title: Operations Manager  (Ship Building)
description:
The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day operations of the yard, including Production, Logistics, Maintenance, Safety, Resource Management, and overall project execution. The role ensures that operational activities are carried out safely, efficiently, within budget, and in accordance with required quality standards and project timelines.

The Operations Manager will work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and effective utilization of manpower, materials, equipment, and other resources. The role also focuses on continuous improvement, cost optimization, operational performance, and timely delivery of projects.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Yard Operations: Oversee and manage the day-to-day activities of the yard, including production, logistics, maintenance, material movement, and other operational activities.
* Safety Management: Implement and enforce safety procedures, policies, and applicable regulations across yard operations. Conduct or coordinate risk assessments and promote a strong safety-conscious work culture.
* Resource Management: Plan and manage manpower, materials, machinery, tools, and equipment to ensure optimum utilization and availability for project requirements.
* Interdepartmental Coordination: Coordinate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and efficient project execution.
* Budget & Cost Management: Develop and manage operational budgets, monitor expenditure, control operational costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising safety or quality.
* Performance Monitoring: Define and track operational KPIs, analyze performance and productivity data, identify operational gaps, and implement corrective and improvement measures.
* Project Management: Oversee operational aspects of projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines, budgets, technical requirements, and quality standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, layouts, resource utilization, and workflows. Implement initiatives to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.
* Quality Control & Assurance: Coordinate with the Quality team to implement and monitor quality control procedures and ensure that vessels meet required specifications, standards, and customer requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, service providers, regulatory agencies, and other external stakeholders as required.
* Staffing & Training: Participate in manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance monitoring, and development of operational and project personnel.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and support long-term operational strategies and plans aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and future projects.
* Inventory & Material Management: Oversee the availability and utilization of materials, consumables, tools, and equipment. Coordinate with relevant departments to maintain adequate stock levels and minimize shortages and operational delays.
* Maintenance Management: Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of yard machinery, equipment, tools, utilities, and infrastructure to minimize downtime and ensure operational readiness.
* Customer Coordination: Maintain professional relationships with clients, support project-related customer interactions, and coordinate the timely resolution of operational or service-related concerns.
* Compliance & Documentation: Ensure operational activities comply with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, environmental, and organizational requirements. Maintain appropriate operational records, reports, and documentation.
* Reporting: Prepare and present periodic reports on production progress, operational performance, resource utilization, project status, costs, safety, quality, and other key operational indicators to management.

**Job Requirements**

* Education :Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Experience**

* Relevant managerial experience in Operations, Production, Yard Management, Project Management, or a similar function.
* Experience in shipbuilding, boat manufacturing, marine, heavy engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, or a related industry is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating multiple projects/activities simultaneously.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of production and yard operations.
* Strong project planning and execution skills.
* Knowledge of safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Effective manpower and resource planning skills.
* Budgeting, cost control, and cost optimization capabilities.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent interdepartmental coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of quality management and continuous improvement practices.
* Ability to monitor KPIs and prepare management reports.
* Strong inventory, logistics, and material management skills.
* Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities and project deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office and relevant ERP/project management systems.

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Operations Team Lead
description:
Job Description: Operations Team Lead

**Company:**
Lumina Consulting

**Location:**
Kerala, India

**Job Type:**
Full-time | Hybrid

Company Description

Lumina Consulting supports a UK-based client specialising in the wholesale and distribution of branded products sourced from across the world, with a strong focus on beauty, cosmetics, haircare, personal care, hygiene, and perfumery.

Established in 2017, the client initially operated as a retailer and has since expanded into the B2B wholesale and distribution sector. The business manages an extensive product portfolio, with more than 100,000 SKUs in its inventory, and distributes selected European brands within the UK market.

The company is committed to operational excellence, product authenticity, customer satisfaction, and building efficient, scalable business processes across its retail and wholesale operations.

Role Description

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on, and results-driven
**Operations Team Lead**
to oversee daily business operations and lead a team responsible for e-commerce operations, wholesale order processing, inventory management, and customer service.

This full-time hybrid role is based in Kerala, India, combining on-site responsibilities with some work-from-home flexibility.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining accurate inventory records, managing online product listings, coordinating order fulfilment, and ensuring that customer orders are processed and dispatched on time.

The role requires a strong understanding of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon, alongside experience in wholesale operations, inventory control, and people management. The ideal candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of operational challenges, identifying process improvements, and ensuring that the team consistently meets its performance targets.

Key Responsibilities1. E-commerce Operations

* Oversee day-to-day operations across e-commerce marketplaces and online sales channels.
* Manage Amazon inventory, product listings, stock availability, pricing updates, and order fulfilment processes.
* Coordinate product listing creation, content updates, SKU mapping, EAN/barcode verification, and product data accuracy.
* Monitor marketplace performance, operational metrics, account health, and order processing standards.
* Ensure stock levels and product information remain accurate across all relevant sales channels.
* Identify and resolve listing errors, stock discrepancies, order issues, and other marketplace-related operational problems.

2. Wholesale Operations and Order Management

* Supervise B2B wholesale order processing, customer account requirements, and order fulfilment.
* Coordinate with sales and customer service teams to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
* Monitor outstanding orders, supplier availability, delivery schedules, and dispatch timelines.
* Support wholesale customer enquiries, order updates, and operational escalations.
* Ensure wholesale orders meet agreed service levels and customer expectations.

3. Inventory and Warehouse Coordination

* Maintain accurate inventory records across ERP, inventory management systems, and e-commerce platforms.
* Monitor stock movements, discrepancies, incoming deliveries, and outgoing shipments.
* Coordinate with warehouse and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure appropriate stock control procedures are followed, including SKU, EAN, barcode, expiry-date, and product-condition checks where applicable.

4. Team Leadership and Performance Management

* Lead, supervise, and coach team members to achieve operational objectives.
* Allocate tasks, establish priorities, monitor productivity, and ensure accountability.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and training.
* Encourage teamwork, effective communication, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Address operational errors, delays, and performance issues promptly and professionally.

5. Customer Service and Service-Level Management

* Ensure customer enquiries and complaints are handled professionally and within agreed response times.
* Monitor order accuracy, dispatch performance, delivery issues, and customer satisfaction.
* Resolve escalated operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

6. Reporting and Process Improvement

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including order processing time, inventory accuracy, dispatch performance, listing accuracy, and team productivity.
* Prepare regular operational reports and highlight risks, delays, and areas requiring management attention.
* Analyse operational data to identify inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve consistency and scalability.
* Work closely with sales, technology, logistics, and senior management to support business growth.

Qualifications and Required Skills

* Proven experience in e-commerce operations, preferably with hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, product listings, SKU management, and order processing.
* Experience in wholesale, distribution, retail, or FMCG operations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and manage a team effectively.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in customer service, order escalations, and maintaining high service standards.
* Ability to analyse operational data, monitor KPIs, and prepare performance reports.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including data analysis, filtering, sorting, and reporting.
* Experience with ERP, warehouse management, or inventory management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented approach to work.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and make sound operational decisions.
* A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with Amazon, eBay, Shopify, or other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Familiarity with B2B wholesale platforms and high-volume order processing.
* Experience coordinating with third-party logistics (3PL) providers.
* Knowledge of beauty, cosmetics, personal care, haircare, or perfumery products.
* Experience supporting UK-based businesses or working with international teams.
* Familiarity with inventory systems such as Odoo or similar ERP platforms.

Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate will be a dependable and confident leader who combines strong execution skills with a commercial mindset.

They should demonstrate integrity, ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to teamwork. They must be willing to get involved in day-to-day operational tasks while also developing better processes and helping the business scale.

**The objective of this role is simple: build a disciplined, efficient, and accountable operations team that delivers accurate orders, maintains reliable inventory, supports wholesale growth, and consistently meets customer expectations.**

title: Engineering Manager – PHP & Web Tech
description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead software engineering teams, optimize delivery processes, and drive people development across multiple product teams. The role primarily focuses on engineering team management, delivery excellence, Agile execution, and stakeholder collaboration rather than hands-on development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage software engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Drive sprint planning, roadmap execution, delivery tracking, and risk management.
* Coach engineers and Technical Leads, manage performance, and support career development.
* Monitor engineering KPIs, including DORA and SPACE metrics, to improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Establish effective Agile practices, CI/CD workflows, release governance, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and delivery blockers.
* Promote team engagement, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven engineering management experience, including managing teams of 5+ engineers.
* Strong people leadership, mentoring, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics, engineering delivery KPIs, CI/CD, and software release processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, delivery commitments, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong communication and distributed-team management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Previous experience in software development or technical leadership.
* Familiarity with PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, or API gateways.
* Experience with SaaS products, API-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of SRE, platform reliability, and engineering process transformation.

title: Service Manager
description:
Job Purpose

To manage the overall operations of the Honda two-wheeler service department, ensure excellent customer satisfaction, achieve service revenue and profitability targets, maintain service quality, and lead the service team efficiently.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Service Operations**

* Manage daily workshop operations, including vehicle reception, job allocation, repairs, servicing, quality control and vehicle delivery.
* Ensure timely completion of service jobs and optimum workshop productivity.
* Monitor workshop capacity, technician efficiency, bay utilisation and vehicle turnaround time.
* Ensure compliance with Honda service standards, SOPs and warranty procedures.
* Coordinate with the Spare Parts Department to ensure the availability of required parts.

**B. Revenue and Profitability**

* Achieve monthly service revenue, labour sales, spare parts sales and other service-related targets.
* Monitor labour revenue per vehicle, average repair order value and paid-service conversion.
* Increase customer-pay jobs, periodic maintenance, repeat repairs and additional service sales.
* Control workshop expenses, manpower costs, consumables and operational wastage.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly service performance reports.

**C. Customer Satisfaction**

* Ensure professional customer handling and timely vehicle delivery.
* Monitor customer complaints, repeat repairs, service quality issues and customer feedback.
* Ensure effective follow-up with customers after service.

Train and develop supervisors to take on more responsibility.

Adherence to the production plan

Conversion cost per unit

First Pass Yield and customer complaints traced to manufacturing

Machine downtime

Safety incidents, and closure of inspection and audit observations

Hands-on shopfloor leadership

Production planning and scheduling

Practical problem solving on quality and machine issues

Awareness of cost and wastage

Ability to train and manage a shopfloor team

Clear and regular reporting
